subject: Request: shift demo on 12/17 for CTO landing — proposed buffer
messages:
From: Stephen Choi <stephen.choi@bluefinhealth.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com, Elena Morris <elena.morris@bluefinhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Dec 2025 14:05:00 -0800 (PST)
Subject: 12/17 demo — CTO possible to join (flight lands at 10:30)

Hi Tessa / Elena,

Quick heads-up — our CTO (coming in from SEA) just confirmed he wants to join the demo on 12/17. Flight lands at 10:30am PT, but with customs/ride he realistically can't be in the call at 10:00. Would Redwood be OK moving the session to 11:00 or 11:15 PT so he can get there live? If not, we can have him dial in late but he'd prefer to be present for the architecture portion.

I've attached a short pre-read the CTO asked to skim. If moving the slot isn't possible we understand — just trying to get alignment so we can have the right execs on.

Thanks,
Stephen
CTO, Bluefin Health
(attachment: pre-read-architecture.pdf)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephen Choi <stephen.choi@bluefinhealth.com>, Elena Morris <elena.morris@bluefinhealth.com>, Bluefin Health Sales Ops <ops@bluefinhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Dec 2025 15:10:00 -0800 (PST)
Subject: Re: 12/17 demo — CTO possible to join (flight lands at 10:30)

Thanks Stephen — looping the delivery crew.

Ben / Kim / Marcus / Lauren — the ask from Bluefin: CTO wants to be there live and will likely need ~30–45 minutes buffer after landing. Options I see:
- Move the main demo from 10:00 -> 11:15 PT (preferred) to guarantee CTO presence and keep full agenda intact.
- Keep current 10:00 slot but split the session: 10:00–10:30 product overview (no CTO expected), 10:45–11:15 architecture deep dive (CTO to join live). Requires us to step through the agenda differently and potentially extend.
- Keep time but plan to record the architecture portion and run a short follow-up working session with CTO (less ideal).

My recommendation: shift to 11:15 PT with a clear backup presenter plan. Kim should lead the architecture piece; Marcus can run the live demo if we need to compress. Lauren, can you own the calendar update and CS handoff if timing changes? Ben, confirm whether the prospect still has an internal conflict later in their day (Elena / ops).

I'll propose 11:15 in the invite only if Ops confirms they can move.

Tessa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | tessa_morgan@redwood.com

Date: Mon, 15 Dec 2025 16:00:00 -0800 (PST)
Subject: Re: 12/17 demo — CTO possible to join (flight lands at 10:30)

All — I did a quick check with ops (internal) and Bluefin's calendar looks free later morning. A couple operational notes:
- 11:00 PT is doable but because of customs/traffic I'd push for 11:15 PT as a safer buffer.
- If we shift to 11:15, we should shorten the intro and reserve 35 minutes for architecture + Q&A. That keeps the CTO focused on the technical section.
- Kimberly: you're primary for architecture. Marcus: agreed to be backup for interactive demo and to run through any live quantization/cost questions.
- Lauren: can you prepare a 1-slide summary for execs (cost, SLA, next steps) to close the meeting in 5 minutes? Attach to calendar.

If Bluefin confirms, I'll tentatively update calendars and include the 'backup coverage' note in the invite.

Ben
Solutions Leader, Redwood Inference

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Stephen Choi <stephen.choi@bluefinhealth.com>, Elena Morris <elena.morris@bluefinhealth.com>, Bluefin Health Sales Ops <ops@bluefinhealth.com>

Date: Mon, 15 Dec 2025 16:35:00 -0800 (PST)
Subject: Confirming: move to 11:15 PT on 12/17 (CTO landing buffer + backup plan)

Hi Stephen / Elena — thanks for the quick update. Bluefin Ops looked and confirmed they're able to move the session. We will shift the demo to 11:15 PT on 12/17 and brief the CTO on arrival contingencies. Calendar invite will be updated in a few minutes with the revised meet link and attachments.

Plan for the live session:
- 11:15–11:25: Short executive intro + 1-slide cost/SLA summary (Lauren)
- 11:25–12:00: Architecture deep-dive and Q&A (Kimberly primary; Marcus backup for live demo)
- 12:00: Close and next steps; capture any follow-up engineering asks.

If the CTO is delayed beyond 11:25, we will start with the intro and bring him in for the architecture portion; we'll make sure the most impactful pieces are recorded.

Attachments: demo-agenda.pdf (attached), pre-read-architecture.pdf (from Stephen).

Meet link / updated invite: https://meet.google.com/redwood-bluefin-demo
HubSpot: HS-89321

Thanks everyone — Lauren, please update the invite and include the attachments. Ben / Kim / Marcus — 30-minute dry run tomorrow morning at 9:15 PT to prep the compressed architecture flow.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
